title: Peter Mandelson declines to apologise for association with Jeffrey Epstein
summary: Former UK ambassador says he was sorry for system that did not give victims the protection they were entitled to expect Peter Mandelson declined to apologise to Jeffrey Epstein’s victims for remaining friends with the paedophile financier after his conviction but said he was sorry for “a system” that meant Epstein’s victims were ignored. The Labour peer, who was sacked as US ambassador when details of his support for Epstein emerged in September, gave an interview to the BBC on Sunday, saying he had paid a “calamitous” price for his association with the “evil monster”.
